(iv) Any other relief/reliefs to which the petitioner may be found entitled in the facts and circumstances of this case.
3. The matter relates to a piece of land, the description of which is/are as follows:
Tauzi No. 228, Thana no. 14 CS, Khata no. 308, Plot no. 1399, Area-2829 Sq.ft.
situated in Mauza Pahadi, P.S.- Alamganj, now Agamkuan, District- Patna.
4.

The petitioner claims it to be his land which now stands acquired vide Acquisition Proceeding No.
04 of 2008-09.
However, the complaint is that despite he being the legal owner of the said plot, no payment has been made.
5. A counter affidavit was earlier filed on behalf of the respondent nos. 5 to 7 in the year 2019 and paragraph 8 and 9 read as follows:
8. That it is relevant to state that the payment of the compensation amount with regard to 0.86 acres of land for the aforesaid project has already been made.

9. That in view of the objections raised in this regard by Chandra Kishore Patna High Court CWJC No.1146 of 2018(5) dt.05-01-2026 Thakur, the Additional District Land Acquisition Officer, Patna vide letter no.-197, dated-24-01- 19 has referred the matter to the Chairman- Cum-Presiding Officer, Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority (LARRA),
Patna under section-64 of the RFCTLARR Act-2013 and has send the records, for deciding the title/share of the land in question.
6. Upon query, what is the present status of the reference made to LARRA, neither parties are in a position to make any submission.
7. In that background, the State respondent is/are required to file a fresh affidavit on the present status/development.

8. As prayed, three weeks' time is granted to hand over the copy to the learned counsel for the petitioner before filing it in the office so that he can file reply to it in next one week.
9.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-
